text.p: Abraxas Petroleum Corp said Tuesday it is purchasing various "net profits interests", presently owned by an undisclosed pension fund, in two South Texas producing oil fields, the East White Point Field and the Stedman Island Field.

Abraxas said that the total purchase price for the additional interests in the two properties is $9.3 million and that it already has working interests in both properties and is presently the operator of each.
The company said it now has a 30 percent interest in the East White Point Field, in San Patricio County, Texas, and is acquiring a similar interest from the pension fund investor.

As of June 30, the fields proved reserves were 4,054,000 barrels of oil equivalent, 61 percent of which was natural gas. A cryogenic natural gas processing plant with a capacity of 25 million cubic feet daily is located on the property.
Abraxas said it also currently has a 30 percent working interest in the Stedman Island Field is in Nueces County, Texas, and is acquiring the remaining balance from the selling pension fund investor.
As of June 30, proved reserves were 1,141,000 barrels of oil equivalent, 67.9 percent natural gas.
